name: Genius Franklyn
missingPieces: Task 3 Artefact A used an invented plaintext; capstone D2 omitted Artefact 04 and used an incorrect layered memo plaintext.
feedback: Your Task 7 response is complete and well supported, with the empty signature, RFC 7519 Section 6.1, CVE-2015-9235, and the algorithm allow-list fix all clearly explained. Task 6 identifies the hash families and urgency order well, though a few claims about bcrypt formatting and account D satisfying every NIST verifier requirement are overstated. Task 3 loses the Artefact A row because the Vigenere key and plaintext were invented; B and C are correctly decoded. The board brief is useful and directly addresses key discipline, HMAC-style integrity, and config secret audits. The capstone D1 is structured, but D2 omits Artefact 04 entirely and replaces the expected layered memo with an incorrect `ADMIN PORTAL STILL LIVE` plaintext, so the single flat fabrication penalty applies.
